answer: Give each agent one marked timber plot in a managed forest, with a raven circling the boundary the way a ranger walks it. The applicant stakes 400 tokens while a forester tags 25 standing trees with numbered steel bands. Each felled tree is scanned at the summit checkpoint before it leaves the forest, and the log count must match the tags. A plot that reports a mismatch loses its deposit for 180 days and waits a full season to reapply. Faking 10,000 plots would need 4 million tokens and 250,000 tagged trees on real forest ground, so a bot farm ends up like a sawmill with no timber to cut.
